content:
sam: quick sync — onboarding for rtx-8k model. I uploaded weights and a tokenizer but noticed a prompt-wrapping discrepancy when running chat templates.
anya: thanks. can you drop the gs path?
sam: gs://redwood-models/onboard/rlm-8k/v1/weights.pt and tokenizer files under gs://redwood-models/onboard/rlm-8k/v1/tokenizer/*
lee: on it. which tokenizer? sentencepiece or bpe?
sam: bpe, vocab_size=50280. tokenizer.json + merges. I think special sentinel is <MSG_SEP> and we use ``
kevin: hmm we usually map sentinel -> 50279. Did you add a pad token? we expect pad_id=50280
sam: i didn't add pad explicitly. default pad gets appended by our loader. suspect off-by-one in pad vs eos.
anya: can you paste the loader config?
sam:
```
loader:
  tokenizer_path: /mnt/tokenizer/tokenizer.json
  special_tokens:
    bos: 50278
    eos: 50279
    pad: 50280
  preserve_bos: false
  strip_chat_sentinels: true
```
lee: strip_chat_sentinels=true will remove sentinels pre-tokenize? that's dangerous for chat templates.
kevin: if preserve_bos=false the client may inject BOS and then runtime strips it again -> duplicate positions
natalie: @lee want to run a smoke generate with the canonical chat template? I can help check logs.
lee: running now, using sample prompt: "system: You are helpful\nuser: explain nested lists" will post logs in 5
devops-bot: scheduled job rtm-smoke-2109876543 started on rtx-8k-01
lee: logs: generation returned token sequence with an extra `` in middle of response
sam: that's the bug i saw. model tokenizer treats `` as EOS token id 50279 but client appends eos later causing mid-response truncation
kevin: quick fix: set preserve_bos=true and strip_chat_sentinels=false, and add a post-tokenize trim that removes leading/trailing pad/eos duplicates
anya: can you propose a minimal config change? then i'll update onboarding manifest
sam: propose:
```
preserve_bos: true
strip_chat_sentinels: false
post_token_trim: true
trim_tokens: [pad, eos, bos]
```
lee: applied locally, re-ran smoke: no mid-response `` now, but trailing pad tokens remain in log. need to enforce post-trim on server side too.
natalie: created an onboarding PR #412 with the config changes and notes. @kevin pls review, @sam can you add the tokenizer mapping file to the GCS path? i left a checklist in PR
sam: will upload tokenizer_map.json with explicit id mapping in 10m
kevin: reviewing PR now. two comments: add test for chat template with nested system->user and ensure eval harness runs. also add a small integration test that asserts no internal eos mid-sequence.
sam: ack. will add tests and ping.
anya: thanks all. TL;DR: weights + tokenizer uploaded, found EOS-in-middle bug caused by strip/preserve mismatch. PR created to change default to preserve bos and disable sentinel stripping; add server-side post-trim. next: @sam upload mapping, @kevin review, @lee run canary.
lee: canary run scheduled for tomorrow 07:30 PDT
devops-bot: deploy-canary scheduled for rtx-8k-01 @ 2026-03-18T14:30:00Z
sam: awesome, thanks :thumbsup:
